category_title: Typically developing student who seeks attention and connects tasks to personal life
scenario_title: Spontaneous outbursts and peer competition during vocabulary introduction
minimal_context: The student is participating in a small group discussion to learn new vocabulary words from the book 'The Day the Crayons Quit'.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are going to talk about the vocabulary words from 'The Day the Crayons Quit'. The first word is 'declared'.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I know what that means! I want to say it first before anyone else!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: What do you think it means?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Declared. It means you say something really loud!

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's see if your classmates have anything to add.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Yelling out spontaneously) No, listen to me! I have more to say about it than them!

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: We are going to talk about the vocabulary words from 'The Day the Crayons Quit'. The first word is 'declared'.

STUDENT: I know what that means! I want to say it first before anyone else!

TUTOR: What do you think it means?

STUDENT: Declared. It means you say something really loud!

TUTOR: Let's see if your classmates have anything to add.

STUDENT: (Yelling out spontaneously) No, listen to me! I have more to say about it than them!
